subject: HarborHealth procurement form blocking exec demo — proposing async alternative
messages:
From: Lucy Park <lucy.park@harborhealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@harborhealth.com; a.mendel@harborhealth.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor intake: questionnaire + exec demo timeline

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the overview last week. Our procurement team started the intake and attached the latest vendor questionnaire (Harbor_vendor_questionnaire_v4.xlsx). Legal flagged a few items they need clarified (data residency, audit log retention, and encryption in transit).

Per Harbor policy we need the intake to be completed in the vendor portal before we can schedule an executive-level demo with our CIO — they want to see a completed intake and NDA on file.

Can your team fill out section 3 (security & data handling) and return the spreadsheet? Our legal contact Aaron is copied. Also we need a signed NDA (DocuSign link below) before exec invites go out.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/sign/ABC123
Vendor portal intake: https://vendorportal.harborhealth.com/intake/HH-092

Quick ask: if the intake will take >48 hours to complete on your side, can we instead do a short 20-minute exec sync (no demo) next week to cover business outcomes and timeline? Our CIO will be traveling Thurs–Fri so Wed morning is the only feasible slot.

Thanks,
Lucy
Lucy Park
Sr. Sourcing Manager, HarborHealth
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Lucy Park <lucy.park@harborhealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com; markus_klein@redwood.com; neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: questionnaire + exec demo timeline

Lucy — thanks for the clarity and for attaching the intake. We can absolutely get section 3 filled quickly. Grace will lead the security writeup and I can route the NDA to our legal ops to sign and return.

Plan proposal (short):
- Today: Grace will populate security answers and attach our SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
- EOD tomorrow: legal to sign NDA via DocuSign
- Once intake + NDA are in portal, we re-open CIO demo scheduling (we know Wed is tight)

If Harbor needs an immediate sync for business context (no technical demo), we can hold a 20-minute slot Wed 9:30–9:50 PT. Otherwise, if the intake closes within 48 hours we can keep to the working plan.

Markus — can you confirm you can cover commercial terms if we do the short sync? Neha will own the calendar coordination.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Lucy Park <lucy.park@harborhealth.com>; sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com; neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: questionnaire + exec demo timeline

Lucy — I started on section 3 and have a few clarifying notes in the attached spreadsheet (Harbor_vendor_questionnaire_v4.xlsx). Short answers below: 

- Data residency: Redwood can commit to EU/US region pinning for customer data; default is multi-region but we support customer-specified residency for production workloads.
- Audit logs: We retain detailed request/response logs and token-level billing traces for 365 days by default; longer retention available via the Enterprise package.
- Encryption: TLS1.3 in transit; at-rest encryption via KMS (customer-managed option supported).

I attached our SOC2 summary and a short proposed agenda for the exec sync (proposed-exec-demo-agenda.pdf). If you prefer, I can also record a 12-minute technical walkthrough that highlights architecture and SSO flow — that could be uploaded to the portal as an interim deliverable.

Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: procurement@harborhealth.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com; grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: a.mendel@harborhealth.com; lucy.park@harborhealth.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: questionnaire + exec demo timeline

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround. A couple of process notes from Harbor procurement/legal: 

1) Our policy requires the completed intake AND a signed NDA to be visible in the vendor portal before we distribute an executive calendar invite. We can't make exceptions for exec demos.
2) The portal also expects a technical artifact (arch diagram or short recorded demo) to be linked to the intake when security answers are provided.

The CIO's schedule is tight this week (travel Wed–Fri). Given the policy, we should either: 
- Wait until the intake shows complete (expected by Thu if your team returns section 3 + signed NDA by EOD Wed), or
- Proceed with a 20-minute business-context sync with the CIO's deputy (no exec demo), then follow up with a completed intake + exec demo the following week.

Please confirm which path you prefer.

Aaron Mendel
HarborHealth Legal (on behalf of procurement)
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: procurement@harborhealth.com; lucy.park@harborhealth.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com; markus_klein@redwood.com; neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: questionnaire + exec demo timeline

Aaron / Lucy — thanks for the direction. We want to keep momentum. Final confirmation: 

Option A (preferred): We finish section 3 today and have the NDA signed by EOD Wed; upload the architecture diagram + 12-min recorded walkthrough to the portal. If that completes by Thu morning, please schedule the executive demo for next week (we'll provide 3 availability windows).

Option B (contingency): If Harbor procurement strictly needs the exec slot this week, we propose a 20-minute business-context sync with the CIO's deputy Wed 9:30–9:50 PT; Redwood will not present live demo content in that call.

We're working the NDA now — I routed it to Legal Ops this morning. Grace is finishing the portal artifact and I will ping once everything is uploaded. Neha will propose the three demo windows in a follow-up calendar invite.

Appreciate the flexibility — we'll get the portal intake green-lit.

Sergio
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments referenced: Harbor_vendor_questionnaire_v4.xlsx (filled: section 3), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, proposed-exec-demo-agenda.pdf
